hero.subtext:
I am Nate Winter, a Milwaukee-based designer and art director focused on the visual world around products.

Through 3D, motion, packaging, and brand design, I create work that helps brands feel more refined, more intentional, and more complete.

about.title: Strong creative direction, rendered honestly.
body: I'm a digital media artist and motion designer based in Milwaukee, WI. I help brands bring their products, ideas, and stories to life through 3D product visualization and motion design, guided by strong creative direction and brand thinking.

My journey started young. I was rarely seen without a sketchbook in hand. Movies, music, video games, skateboarding… everything I loved became fuel for the art I created. My obsession with creating something out of nothing is what still drives me today.
When I pursued graphic design professionally, a lightbulb went off. I realized my creativity could serve a purpose beyond expression, which pushed me to explore every tool available.

The discovery of 3D design and animation became the turning point. It opened up limitless ways to translate ideas into photoreal product visuals and motion. Through this process, I combine storytelling, design, and precision into a single craft, transforming brand identity and packaging into fully realized 3D product visuals with clarity and intent.

Today, I channel that experience into helping brands stand out through 3D product visualization, creative direction, and motion design that feels intentional, elevated, and built to connect with their audience.

services.title: Product animation
services.desc: Launch films, scroll-stopping loops, and paid-social cutdowns, built to make the product feel alive in motion. All on one locked art direction, so every frame stays of a piece.

services.title: Product stills
services.desc: Photoreal 3D stills for PDPs, paid social, retail, and Amazon A+, with control a camera can't give you. Drawn from the same visual system as the film, so the whole campaign reads as one thing.

services.title: Brand & packaging design
services.desc: Identity systems, packaging, label design, and the visual language that earns the shelf. Often paired with a stills library, so the brand lands cohesive from day one.

services.title: Creative direction & consulting
services.desc: Visual strategy, campaign direction, and production guidance, by the day or week. For teams that want sharper creative decisions and an art-directed set of eyes on the brief.

contact.title: Have a product that needs a stronger visual world? Let's talk.
contact.lead: I take a range of projects each quarter, from single deliverables and short engagements to multi-month campaigns and ongoing creative direction. Also open to full-time and contract roles with the right team. Share your scope, timeline, or opportunity. A short note is all I need to get started.
expect: I reply within two business days.
We hop on a 30-minute fit call.
You get a fixed-scope proposal within a week.
